instruction: Enable automatic screen locking on my Ubuntu system for security purposes.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling automatic screen locking. Setup disables lock-enabled (false), agent must enable it (true). Uses existing vm_command_line getter and exact_match metric. Verified: gsettings returns 'true\n' when enabled.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly extracts screen lock state via gsettings command
Metric logic uses exact_match to compare result with expected 'true\n' output
Expected value 'true\n' is semantically correct for enabled screen lock state
Complete coverage: evaluator fully verifies the screen lock enable requirement
Semantic flow is correct: setup disables -> agent enables -> evaluator checks enabled state
No edge cases or state timing issues: gsettings is a synchronous system setting query
